notes: How long a model takes to load from Lustre, with and without the engine reading it ahead
(--load-threads, readahead.rs): objective (5), loading, and the engine change it measures.
Every point is cold: the runner drops the model's files from the node's page cache before
the server starts (posix_fadvise DONTNEED), and records load.cache = evicted. Each point is
alone on the node (exclusive), so no other point's reads share the node's link meanwhile.
On a LUMI-G node on 06-10-2026 (sbatch_lustre_probe.slurm) one stream read 178 MB/s and
sixteen 2,283 MB/s through the page cache; at one stream the Coder-480B had not loaded after
the runner's hour (c02). On 07-10-2026 the 27B and 235B loads showed llama.cpp alone
reading at 0.7-1.3 GB/s and readers slowing it (235B: 110 s without, 128 s with 16), so
--load-threads 0 was added to the 480B and 671B groups and made the engine's default.
trial repeats a load: each is its own point, run on whatever node is free.
